text:
emma: quick thread  dark theme tune-up: pls weigh in on 1) sparkline / microchart visibility at 1px, 2) inline code contrast vs code block treatment, 3) legend overlay behavior for mixed overlays.
rafael: paste the live tokens? easier to call out precise deltas.
june: also an ask: logs viewer vs playground editor have subtly different keyword treatments. worth aligning semantics first.
emma: current snapshot: 
```
--bg: #060707
--panel: #0c0e10
--panel-2: #121315
--muted: #95a0a0
--cold-accent: #66baff
--warm-accent: #ff9980
--inline-code-bg: #0a0c0e
--inline-code-fg: #dbeffb
--code-block-bg: #0b0d0f
```
rafael: `inline-code-fg` `#dbeffb` on `#0a0c0e` is ~4.2:1. contrast-bot will flag. We can either push fg to `#eaf8ff` or nudge inline bg lighter.
contrast-bot: auto-check: `#dbeffb` on `#0a0c0e` => 4.2:1 (recommended >=4.5). Suggest `#eaf8ff` => 4.6:1.
june: preference is to keep block/bg relationship stable (preserve mood) and raise inline fg only. Less churn for docs/screenshots.
oli: (oli) microcharts: retina and low-brightness phones kill 1px strokes. Options: 1) keep 1px + subtle halo, 2) 1.2px stroke, 3) 1px double stroke (thin opaque + translucent outer). I vote 1 + halo (keeps crispness).
rafael: agree; halo at 6% white usually does the trick: `box-shadow: 0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.06)`. Also add pattern fallback for error series (dashed or diagonal hatch).
emma: legend options: A) per-item pill w/ icon, B) full-width translucent strip, C) floating compact pill. For mixed overlays, B reduces occlusion. Thoughts?
june: B, but ensure strip uses the panel color not pure black so it blends (`rgba(8,10,12,0.82)`).
contrast-bot: check: `rgba(8,10,12,0.82)` on `--panel-2` passes 6.7:1.
oli: syntax note: editor uses bright cyan for keywords; logs should use a slightly muted cyan + bold for emphasis. Will draft a mapping: keyword -> cyan (editor), keyword -> cyan-muted + bold (logs).
rafael: copy nit: settings helper text for Temperature says "higher = more random"  can we reword to "higher = more varied responses (less deterministic)"? clearer for new users.
june: +1. Also change "Top-p" helper to "higher = broader token distribution" (short).
emma: action items: 1) oli to prototype halo + 1.2px stroke variants in storybook (due today EOD). 2) me to update inline token to `--inline-code-fg: #eaf8ff` and push color-a11y run. 3) june to produce editor vs logs token map and rationale. 4) rafael to add legend-strip CSS sample and accessibility note for pattern fallbacks.
oli: quick snippet for halo test: 
```
.sparkline path { stroke-width:1; stroke:var(--cold-accent); filter: drop-shadow(0 0 6px rgba(255,255,255,0.06)); shape-rendering:geometricPrecision }
```
rafael: legend strip sample: 
```
.legend-strip { background: rgba(8,10,12,0.82); padding:6px 10px; border-radius:8px }
```
june: will include Deuteranopia/Protanopia sims in the token map. Keep patterns as first-class fallback in docs.
contrast-bot: reminder: run `design-kit color-a11y --threshold 4.5` and attach report.
emma: thanks all  i'll bump the inline token and post the report here. :sparkles:
